lines.name: NATSO
lines.subject: lou
lines.text: The Henderson deck. All of it again. On my desk by eight.

lines.name: YOU
lines.subject: you
lines.text: You signed off on it Friday.

lines.name: NATSO
lines.subject: lou
lines.text: And tonight I'm un-signing. Partners liked the model, by the way. I told them it was my idea.

lines.name: NATSO
lines.text: Team player. That's what I love about you.

lines.name: YOU
lines.subject: you
lines.text: Nine years old, I watched a man push every chip he had into the middle with nothing. He never showed. The whole room went quiet.

lines.name: YOU
lines.subject: you
lines.text: Somewhere along the way I traded that for a lanyard.

directions.text: sunset through the glass, cleaners' vacuum far off, the air handler hum
Lou leaves frame; the motion-sensor lights click off down the floor, one bank at a time
